offering_description.value: Through its subsidiaries, PRA Group buys nonperforming loan portfolios from banks and credit issuers, manages the accounts, and works with borrowers on repayment. It also buys and files securities and antitrust class action claims and provides fee-based recovery services to institutional investors and corporate clients.

quotes.quote: We purchase nonperforming loans from banks and credit issuers in the Americas, Europe and Australia and collaborate with customers to help them resolve their debt.
We purchase and file securities and antitrust class action claims and provide fee-based recovery services to institutional investors and corporate clients in the U.S. and Europe.

With its global headquarters located in Norfolk, Virginia, PRA Group, Inc. is a company that has grown to become one of the largest acquirers of nonperforming loans in the world. Its portfolio operations span multiple countries, 12 languages and 12 currencies. Through its subsidiaries, PRA Group returns essential capital to banks and other lenders, helping expand financial services available to consumers and businesses.
